Trail Runner 3

The Trail Runner 3 is built for wet rock and loose gravel, with a deep-lugged outsole and a rock plate under the forefoot. It is aimed at runners who value grip over cushioning, and it is rated for temperatures down to minus five degrees Celsius.

PropertyValue
Weight (UK 9)292 g

Waterproof ratingWater-resistant upper, not waterproof
WarrantyTwo years against manufacturing defects

The upper is water-resistant rather than waterproof, so shoes will take on water in a prolonged downpour and dry quickly afterwards.
